about: The interventions a CHAOSS signal can propose, and the control chart that raises the signal. interventions/project.mjs proposes each action for every chart whose uor-intervention-signal answer and computation it names; automation/interventions.mjs carries out only what uor-intervention-admission permits. A trust-root file (AUTOMATION.md H3): a change here needs a human.

chart.standard: ISO 7870-2:2023 Shewhart control charts, individuals chart with moving range
chart.why: ISO 7870-2:2023: limits for individual values are the mean plus or minus E2 = 2.66 times the mean moving range of span 2, computed from 20 to 25 preliminary subgroups; test 2 counts nine points. The baseline is the complete weeks before the nine-week window, so the window is judged against limits it did not set.

fill.why: Elasticsearch date_histogram with min_doc_count 0, as GrimoireLab's Kibana panels draw it: a week with no items has count, cardinality and sum 0. An average or a ratio of no items has no value, so a series of one is charted only when every week has a value.

actions.name: record
actions.why: AUTOMATION.md A4: every decision is a CloudEvents 1.0 record the agent loop reads

actions.name: investigate
actions.text: Find the assignable cause: weekly {label} for {subject} {moved} from the week of {since} to the week of {week} ({tests}; centre line {cl}, limits {lcl} to {ucl}, latest {latest}). CHAOSS metrics: {metrics}. Read the items the corpus holds for those weeks, name the cause, and propose the change to the model, the automation or a draft for Alex. Speak to no one outside this repository.
actions.why: ISO 7870-2:2023: a signal of a special cause is investigated and its assignable cause identified before any action on the process; AUTOMATION.md A3: the scheduled agent loop takes agent-task issues

actions.name: maintainer-note
actions.text: Draft for Alex to send, or not, to the maintainers of {subject}: fewer people than usual have been credited with contributions each week ({label}, CHAOSS {metric}) since the week of {since}. CHAOSS asks: {question} Is there anything the Foundation can do to help?
actions.why: CHAOSS Committers and Change Requests ask how robust a community's contributors are; UOR-Foundation/.github GOVERNANCE.md: a repository's maintainers own its community. Sending is a human act (AUTOMATION.md H1).

actions.name: thank-contributors
actions.text: Draft for Alex to post, or not, in the Foundation Discord: more people than usual have been credited with contributions to {subject} each week ({label}, CHAOSS {metric}) since the week of {since}. Thank you to everyone taking part.
actions.why: CHAOSS Community Welcomingness asks how a community welcomes and keeps its contributors; recognition is one of its practices. Posting is a human act (AUTOMATION.md H1).
